staleDataPolicy.liveInPlayUnprovenMarkets: STALE_DATA ALWAYS BLOCKS SETTLEMENT (prevents settling on interrupted/abandoned mid-innings states)
staleDataPolicy.snapshotProvenCompletedInnings: IMMUTABLE SNAPSHOT EVIDENCE OVERRIDES LIVE FEED STALENESS (prevents bets remaining open indefinitely when provider disconnects post-innings)

justification: Once an innings is complete or the boundary line is crossed in-play, the outcome is mathematically immutable. A disconnected upstream stream cannot change the score of an already completed innings.
